question: Can goal-conditioned evidence accumulated across four independent Street View observations of one physical French street sign recover at least three additional canonical street-name candidates over a single first view while reaching at least 90% correct and accepting no disjoint-label or synthetic challenges?

source_contract.dataset: official French Street Name Signs validation split
source_contract.selected_pixel_status_before_freeze: materialized but neither viewed nor OCR-processed
source_contract.selection_disjointness: all 40 selected image SHA-256 values, canonical normalized labels, and distinctive goal tokens are disjoint from all 50 reference examples
source_contract.physical_view_semantics: each 150x150 tile is intended to be a different position and/or time view of the same physical sign; selected examples have four views
source_contract.truth_semantics: image/text is the normalized canonical street name for the multi-view sign sample, not exhaustive text for every visible tile

algorithm_contract.baseline: OCR only the first 150x150 view enlarged 3x; accept one high-confidence exact normalized distinctive goal token or exact goal substring
algorithm_contract.successor: OCR all four views independently at the same 3x scale; accept exact goal evidence from any view, or edit-distance-one evidence only when the same conditioned target token is observed in at least two different views
algorithm_contract.candidate_output: the already conditioned user goal only; no roster rerouting and no sign-instance or portal binding

claim_boundary: This is multi-view canonical street-name recognition Development evidence on pre-cropped signs. FSNS provides the canonical label for the sample but not exhaustive pixel text, per-tile target boxes, camera poses, action labels, metric distance, facade association, entrance or portal ownership, public access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, deployment, or safety. Canonical-label-disjoint challenges are collision diagnostics, not a pixel-absence false-positive rate. Multiple views are observations from different positions/times, not evidence that an L10-selected action caused the recovery. UNKNOWN is neither negative nor known-safe; no conformal, FDR, or open-world guarantee is claimed.
